qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialty additives and process know-how face commoditization and volatile cyclical demand. 5-year average ROIC of ~5.0% and operating margins of 3-7% fail to demonstrate structural moat or economic pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Evonik's 5-year average ROIC of ~5.0% and operating margins of 3-7% demonstrate a severe lack of pricing power and structural moat. The portfolio suffers from commodity cyclicality in animal nutrition (methionine) and high European energy costs.
qualitative.evidence: Evonik reports a 5-year average ROIC of ~5.0% and operating margins fluctuating between -2.3% and 7.3%, failing the 12% GAAP ROIC threshold. Inability to consistently pass through raw material and energy cost inflation highlights commodity price-taker dynamics in major product lines.
